events.body: BP-1055 / DL-7594, mixed ambient box: one 680 g glass jar of passata, two bags loose-leaf tea, one box oat biscuits, one paper bag dried apricots. For breakage we need a photo of the contents as found, uploaded to the order. Where glass has broken in a box with other food we do not assess the other items ourselves. That goes to Thistlecombe Pantry food-safety lead by Email before any remedy is set. Refund or replacement is set by the Refunds team after that.

Opened my box and the passata jar is smashed, sauce and bits of glass all through the bottom. The biscuits are in a sealed box so presumably fine. The apricots are in a paper bag that's got sauce soaked into one corner. Tea looks ok. Can I just pick the glass out and rinse the apricots? Seems a waste otherwise. I've uploaded a photo of how I found it. Would like a refund for the jar at least, £3.40, or just send another one.
